name: Matrix Digital Rain
author: Native Tribes
notes: Phosphor terminal theme with live code rain inside the widgets themselves.
The rain is a second pass inside the SDF widget shader, so it is clipped to
each widget's own distance field -- it follows the chamfers, notches and skew
of whatever shape row is selected instead of being a rectangle pasted on top.
'effect' turns it on for a style row. WHERE it actually draws is the player's
choice, not the theme's: Options -> Interface has Rain on buttons / panels /
list rows, plus a speed multiplier. All default on.
animSpeed is the theme's own fall rate and leadBrightness is how much brighter
the leading glyph is than its trail; the player's speed setting multiplies the
former and hover multiplies it again.
